provenance.paper_title: MemVerse: Multimodal Memory for Lifelong Learning Agents

evidence.paraphrase: Raw multimodal experience becomes hierarchical long-term knowledge.
Periodic distillation transfers essential knowledge into parameters.

A fixed pipeline abstracts experience into hierarchical knowledge. For MemVerse, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of hierarchical multimodal knowledge graph.

evidence.paraphrase: Periodic distillation writes external knowledge into parameters. For MemVerse, this specifically supports a fixed operational optimization objective of hierarchical multimodal knowledge graph.
Adaptive forgetting bounds memory growth under a fixed rule. For MemVerse, this specifically supports progressive decay of stored importance or retention of hierarchical multimodal knowledge graph.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 8): During inference, the operative memory component (hierarchical multimodal knowledge graph) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, a fixed operational optimization objective, progressive decay of stored importance or retention; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
